title: Copilot Reimbursement Outstanding Age
app: Monarch Money, Copilot Money, Plaid-connected accounts, Plaid investments, and brokerage CSV exports ingested into Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=copilot:transaction tag="reimbursable"
| stats sum(amount_usd) as outstanding_usd, max(days_outstanding) as max_days_outstanding by payee
| where outstanding_usd>0 AND max_days_outstanding>30
| sort - max_days_outstanding
description: Uses Copilot reimbursable transactions telemetry to monitor how long outstanding reimbursements have been sitting open in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for money that should have come back already, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Copilot reimbursable transactions data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Payee table of outstanding reimbursement age.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals how long outstanding reimbursements have been sitting open so you can spot money that should have come back already before it becomes annoying.
